sentences.text:
Applicant is in judicial custody in Case Crime No.508 of 2023, under Sections 376,506 Ipc and
Section 5/6 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012, Police Station Kashipur,
District Udham Singh Nagar.
He has sought his release on bail.
2. This is the second bail application.
The first bail application, being BA1 No.1952 of 2024, was rejected on 26.12.2024.
3. Having considered, this Court does not see any new ground, which may entitle the applicant to bail.
Accordingly, the bail application deserves to be rejected.
